title: ESG Research Consultant at Consultivo Group
description:
**Experience:** 7 - 9 years

**Preferred Location:** Dakshineswar, Kolkata, WB

**Travel:** This role may require light travel, so you should be able to **travel 10 to 15 days per month.**

**Job Type:** Full-time | Onsite mode

**About the Role**

The role involves supporting ESG and sustainability projects, including data management, reporting, risk assessment and strategic disclosures, along with training initiatives. Responsibilities include **ESG research, consulting engagements, audits, programme planning**, **report preparation, questionnaire design, Environmental Impact Assessment and compliance coordination** while working with clients, stakeholders and internal teams across industries.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Lead ESG Research, Analytics & Disclosures.

· Design ESG data frameworks based on standards and best practices (BRSR, GRI, TCFD and CDP)

· Maintain ESG dashboards & trackers.

· Drive sustainability initiatives & roadmap (carbon, energy, DEI, supply chain, waste, social projects).

· Lead risk assessment, governance and internal controls.

· Manage audits, certifications and external stakeholders.

· Present ESG performance to leadership and board.

· ESG data collection, validation, analysis, reporting & documentation.

· Coordinate with internal teams for compliance information.

· Develop ESG training & internal capability.

**Key Competencies (Soft Skills):**

· Strong domain knowledge in Sustainability, ESG frameworks, regulatory requirements and data strategy.

· Solid foundation in ESG, Sustainability and Safety principles

· Expertise in ESG reporting, sustainability metrics, research, data analysis and interpretation.

· Strong audit, survey, project management and training capabilities

· Strategic thinking, stakeholder management & leadership

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

· Proficiency in **Advanced Excel**, **Google Workspace**, data analysis & reporting tools

· Familiarity with **Google Meet**

· Excellent client relationship management with a professional, presentable and client-facing approach.

· Strong project planning, coordination and execution abilities.

**Education:**

· Engineering / Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Data Science / Data Analytics / Sustainability & Risk Management / Environmental Studies preferred

· ESG certifications preferred (GRI, CFA ESG, SASB and ISO).

· **Convent schooling (mandatory)**

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Dakshineswar, Kolkata, West Bengal: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Notice Period
* Current CTC (both monthly & annually)
* Expected CTC (both monthly & annually)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* relevant: 7 years (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Preferred)
